title: Metformin as first-line therapy for type 2 diabetes: a meta-analysis
text_summary: Meta-analysis of randomized trials comparing metformin with placebo for type 2 diabetes.
text: We pooled 12 randomized controlled trials with 14,830 patients. Metformin reduced HbA1c by 1.2% compared with placebo and was associated with lower cardiovascular event risk. Findings support metformin as first-line therapy for type 2 diabetes. Subgroup analyses showed consistent benefit across age groups, and the safety profile remained acceptable.
